tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Installation, Commissioning and Maintenance of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) on Rental Basis in 50 existing diesel buses for BMTC
tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Installation, Commissioning and Maintenance of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) on Rental Basis in 50 existing diesel buses for BMTC
tenderSchedule.locationName: Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation Office Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: 4th floor, Mini meeting hall, BMTC central Offices, Shanthinagar, Bengaluru-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully supplied/installed Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) in 50 vehicles during the last three years(i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Purchase Orders/Invoice Copies and work completion certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturer / Authorized Channel Partners / Dealers / Distributor of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems(ADAS) devices are eligible to participate in the tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Manufacturer of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs.1 Crore for proceeding 3 financial years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25).
